title: Molecular Foundry
content: Aerogel National Laboratory. The Molecular Foundry at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is a U.S. Department of Energy user facility supporting synthesis, characterization, and theory for advanced materials. Its nanoscale tools and staff expertise make it relevant for aerogel R&D, porous nanostructures, and structure-property studies.
